# Same job, two very different cuts.

> Free calculator comparing Upwork and Fiverr net payout for the same job price, after platform fees, withdrawal fees, and a tax reserve. Solve for the price to charge on either platform to hit a take-home goal.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
